surface_form: ### 1.1 Why Parallel is the default runtime architecture initially
v2_trace: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA disposition slice
notes: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA — lexical non-wire surface (tests/governance/docs/mega inventories)

surface_form: - **Independence:** In the Parallel architecture, ML stack layers (XGBoost, LSTM, Transformer) consume the **same** canonical feature and sequence inputs but do **not** depend on one another’s outputs at inference time. Failure or bias in one layer does not mechanically propagate into another’s tensor construction.
v2_trace: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA disposition slice
notes: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA — lexical non-wire surface (tests/governance/docs/mega inventories)

surface_form: - **Deployment risk:** Parallel is the **conservative** default for capital-adjacent systems: the stack’s behavior is easier to reason about under stress, model hot-swap, or partial availability.
v2_trace: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA disposition slice
notes: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA — lexical non-wire surface (tests/governance/docs/mega inventories)

surface_form: - **Structural coupling:** In the Cascade architecture, later models may consume **derived signals** from earlier models (e.g., probability vectors or other compact summaries concatenated into sequence or confluence tensors). That coupling can improve empirical fit but introduces **dependency chains** and **error amplification** if upstream calibration shifts.
v2_trace: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA disposition slice
notes: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA — lexical non-wire surface (tests/governance/docs/mega inventories)

surface_form: - **Higher governance burden:** Any change to XGB calibration or LSTM masking affects not only XGB/LSTM marginal quality but also **conditional** inputs to Transformer (and potentially meta-learner inputs), requiring stricter change control.
v2_trace: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA disposition slice
notes: Phase 2 D17 bulk NOT_MARKET_DATA — lexical non-wire surface (tests/governance/docs/mega inventories)
